cases.sentence: От множества коней его ___ покроет тебя.
cases.translation: From the abundance of his horses dust will cover you.
cases.explain: Пыль is the subject of the verb покроет.

cases.sentence: От множества коней его пыль покроет тебя от ___ всадников и колес.
cases.translation: From the abundance of his horses dust will cover you from the noise of horsemen and chariots.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От ____ всадников и колес и колес колебаться будут стены твои.
cases.translation: From the noise of horsemen and wheels your walls will tremble.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От множества коней его пыль покроет тебя когда он входит в ___.
cases.translation: From the abundance of his horses dust will cover you when he enters your gates.
cases.explain: Ворота as direct object of входит takes the accusative.

cases.translation: Your walls will shake from the noise.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governing the cause takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: От ___ коней его пыль покроет тебя.
cases.translation: From the abundance of his horses dust will cover you.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Входит в ворота твои как входит в ___.
cases.translation: He enters your gates as one enters a destroyed city.
cases.explain: The accusative is used with verbs of motion and the preposition в.

cases.sentence: От множества коней ___ пыль покроет тебя.
cases.translation: From the abundance of his horses dust will cover you.
cases.explain: Его is the genitive possessive pronoun.

reading.correct: As if entering an already destroyed city

Walls will collapse and people will flee

reading.correct: The walls trembling as the enemy enters the gates
